_comment: Example config for evaluate_endomapper.py / visualize_endomapper.py. TODO(endomapper-data): fill in the fields below once the EndoMapper download (pending Synapse approval) is available.
_data_root_comment: TODO: point this at the real EndoMapper download directory, containing one subdirectory per sequence (e.g. Seq_001/).
_sequences_comment: null = auto-discover every sequence under data_root that has a COLMAP model; or give an explicit list, e.g. ["Seq_001", "Seq_002"].
_colmap_subdir_comment: Path (relative to each sequence dir) to the folder containing cameras/images/points3D.{bin,txt}. TODO: confirm against the real download.
_frames_subdir_comment: TODO: subdirectory (relative to each sequence dir) containing the video frames referenced by images.bin/txt. null makes EndoMapperSequence try a few common guesses (frames/, images/, rgb/, sequence root) -- set this explicitly once known.
_img_ext_comment: TODO: frame file extension if it differs from what's stored in the COLMAP image NAME field (e.g. if frames were re-extracted as .png but COLMAP was run on .jpg).
_min_points_per_frame_comment: Frames with fewer valid reprojected sparse points than this are skipped in evaluate_endomapper.py and flagged in visualize_endomapper.py's health summary.

models.name: SHADeS++
models._comment: TODO: point this at a real SHADeS++ checkpoint (trained with one of configs/shadespp_tau*.json). `is_shadespp` is auto-detected from "shadespp" appearing in load_weights_folder, matching evaluate_depth.py's convention -- set it explicitly here if your folder naming differs.
